audit.whatIsWrong: The early-lane read is built on a mechanic that does not exist ('her RQ root-tether'), and Level 1 is rated Karma's for the wrong reason — whys[0] says 'she has only Q poke and no RQ root yet'.
audit.why: Karma's root is Focused Resolve (W), a 12s tether at 675 range — it is not on Q and it is not tied to Mantra. What actually makes her Level 1 strong is unique in the game: Mantra is available at level 1 and costs no skill point, so she has an empowered Inner Flame from the first wave. The page misses that entirely and attributes her early power to a Q root she does not have.
audit.corrected: Early stages now credit Mantra-at-level-1 and name Focused Resolve as the W root.
sources: champ-data/_kits/karma.json (R: 'Mantra is available at level 1 and does not require a skill point')

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 is marked as Karma's stage in both layers, and the full layer says 'Karma's ultimate changes the math too' at 6. Karma has no level-6 spike. Meanwhile spikes[1] and whys[4] on the same page both call Level 6 Malphite's single biggest spike.
audit.why: Mantra is online from level 1, so nothing happens to Karma at 6 — she gains a rank, not a new tool. Malphite gains Unstoppable Force, his first gap-closer against a champion who has spent the whole lane at 950 range. The page contradicts itself and the 53.64% win rate over 3018 games sides with the prose.
audit.corrected: Level 6 should read Malphite. Blocked from proposing the side flip — see notes. The phases[4] why text is corrected regardless.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'RQ root' appears roughly seven times across both layers as Karma's signature ability. It is a fabricated mechanic. The genuine decisive interaction — how you break the tether — is never stated.
audit.why: Focused Resolve (W) tethers at 675 range and roots only IF THE TETHER IS NOT BROKEN. Seismic Shard steals Karma's move speed and gives it to Malphite, which is precisely the tool that breaks a range-based tether: you get faster while she gets slower, in the same instant. That interaction is the answer to her main peel and it is absent from the page. Mantra-empowered Focused Resolve extends the root and heals her, which is the version to respect. Separately, the claim that R 'ignores her root' is correct — Unstoppable Force dashes with displacement immunity and the League Wiki note says the dash 'cannot be deterred by crowd control' — but a root landing BEFORE the cast still stops it.
audit.corrected: Focused Resolve named as the W tether, Seismic Shard's speed steal stated as the tether break, and the R nuance made precise.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers in either layer, and the one cooldown that governs the lane is not a fixed number at all.
audit.why: Mantra is 40/38/36/34s, but Gathering Fire reduces it every time one of her damaging abilities hits — so poking you IS how she gets her empowered spell back faster. That is a genuinely different planning rule from a static cooldown and it is not on the page. Focused Resolve is a flat 12s, Inner Flame 9/8/7/6/5s, Inspire 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s.
audit.corrected: Numbers added, with Gathering Fire's Mantra reduction stated as the reason letting her free-poke compounds.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization prescribes 'Iceborn Gauntlet / Frozen Heart (by his AD profile), then Thornmail' against a pure-AP enchanter.
audit.why: Every damaging ability Karma has is magic. Armour and Thornmail do nothing; Mercury's Treads is already correct and should be kept for the Focused Resolve root duration. Ground Slam scaling off armour means you still want some, but the core should be MR.
audit.corrected: MR core with Mercury's Treads kept, and a note that some armour is still wanted for Ground Slam.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flags that neither layer names any Karma ability, plus two suspect names — 'Use Seismic Shard' and 'Granite Shield I'd' — both of which are false positives.
audit.why: Gathering Fire, Inner Flame, Focused Resolve, Inspire and Mantra are the real names; Seismic Shard and Granite Shield are Malphite's own abilities and were written correctly. Inspire is also mis-scoped on the page as a personal peel tool — Mantra-Inspire shields nearby allies too, which is what blunts a Malphite teamfight R.
audit.corrected: Real names used; Mantra-Inspire's team shield added to the late-game text.

edits.before: Karma's window: her Q poke and RQ root-tether chunk you from range before W/E come online, and your Granite Shield gets popped off every wave so it never refreshes.
edits.after: Karma's window: Inner Flame poke and the Focused Resolve root-tether chunk you from range before W/E come online, and Granite Shield gets popped every wave so it never refreshes.

edits.before: Unstoppable Force comes up — R is your first real kill threat, an unstoppable knock-up that ignores her RQ root and any peel attempt to close the gap she's been keeping all lane.
edits.after: Unstoppable Force comes up — your first real kill threat. It dashes displacement-immune, so Focused Resolve cannot deter it once airborne and you finally close the gap she's kept all lane.

edits.before: Land RQ root + tether to kite you out and deny you any chance to walk her down
edits.after: Land Focused Resolve's root-tether to kite you out and deny you the walk-up

edits.before: Use E shield + move speed to disengage your R all-in and peel out of your knock-up range
edits.after: Use Inspire's shield and move-speed boost to peel out of your knock-up range entirely

edits.before: Use Seismic Shard (Q) to steal her move speed and close the gap her poke depends on keeping open
edits.after: Use Seismic Shard to steal her move speed — that is what breaks the Focused Resolve tether

edits.before: Reach level 6 and land Unstoppable Force (R) through her RQ root to punish her short range
edits.after: Reach level 6: Unstoppable Force dashes displacement-immune, so her root can't stop it

edits.before: Karma owns the opening here and I have to accept it. At levels 1-3 I have no trade pattern — my W and E aren't online yet, so she just sits at Q range and pokes, and every time her Q lands it strips the Granite Shield I'd want refreshing between trades. Don't walk up to last-hit into her Q or you'll eat the RQ root-tether and a free poke rotation. I farm with Seismic Shard (Q) at max range, take the chip, and keep my back to the wave so her tether can't drag-fight me into a bad spot. This is survival, not contesting.
edits.after: Karma owns the opening here and I have to accept it. Mantra is up from level 1 without a skill point, so she has an empowered Inner Flame on the first wave while I have no trade pattern at all — and every Q that lands strips the Granite Shield I'd want refreshing between trades. Don't walk up to last-hit into her Q or you'll eat the Focused Resolve tether and a free rotation. I farm with Seismic Shard at max range, take the chip, and keep my back to the wave. This is survival, not contesting.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are still a respect stretch — her RQ root and Q poke out-pressure me until my W armor and E slow give me a way to soak and farm through it, so I stabilize without dominating. Then level 6 flips it: Unstoppable Force is the first thing in this lane she can't kite or root me out of. It's an unstoppable dash that ignores her RQ and her E move-speed peel, so the moment I have R up I have kill pressure she's spent the whole lane denying me. Bait her E shield first, then R in, Q to glue her, and W-E for the trade — don't blow R while her E and Flash are both up.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are still a respect stretch — Focused Resolve and Inner Flame out-pressure me until my W armor and E slow let me soak and farm through it, so I stabilize without dominating. Then level 6 flips it: Unstoppable Force is the first thing she can't kite or root me out of, because it dashes displacement-immune and her root cannot deter it once airborne. Bait her Inspire shield first, then R in, Seismic Shard to steal her speed and glue her, and W-E for the trade — don't blow R while Inspire and Flash are both up.

edits.before: Neither of you wants to commit at level 1 — she has only Q poke and no RQ root yet, and you have no trade pattern, so it's an even last-hitting stretch while you eat a little chip.
edits.after: Neither of you commits at level 1, but respect that Mantra is already up — no skill point needed — so her empowered Inner Flame exists on wave one while you have no trade pattern.

edits.before: Karma's second point gives her real Q poke and the RQ root-tether, and she pops your Granite Shield every wave so it never builds — she owns this window and you just farm at Q range.
edits.after: Her second point gives real Inner Flame poke and the Focused Resolve root-tether, and she pops Granite Shield every wave so it never builds — she owns this window and you farm at max range.

edits.before: Her level-3 RQ root plus Q poke out-pressures you completely; you have no W/E trade yet, so she pokes you off the wave and you concede the lane.
edits.after: Her level-3 Focused Resolve root plus Inner Flame out-pressures you completely; with no W/E trade yet she pokes you off the wave and you concede the lane.

edits.before: Unstoppable Force is your single biggest spike — an unstoppable dash that ignores her RQ root and E peel gives you the kill threat she denied you all lane.
edits.after: Unstoppable Force is your biggest spike — a displacement-immune dash her root can't deter gives you the kill threat she denied you all lane.

edits.before: This is where I take the lane for good. From first item on I stack armor — Bramble, Iceborn, Sunfire — and her Q poke stops mattering: Granite Shield refreshes faster than she can strip it and W's empowered AoE autos plus E's attack-speed slow let me tank her and out-trade if she's anywhere near me. At two items I'm a near-unkillable frontline and she's a squishy enchanter with no escape from a flank, so R into her backline ends fights. I don't need to 1v9 her — I just survive her poke long enough that my armor and my R make her positioning the loser, every teamfight.
edits.after: This is where I take the lane for good. From first item on I stack resists and her Inner Flame poke stops mattering: Granite Shield refreshes faster than she can strip it, and W's empowered AoE autos plus Ground Slam's attack-speed slow let me tank her and out-trade if she's anywhere near me. At two items I'm a near-unkillable frontline and she's a squishy enchanter with no escape from a flank, so R into her backline ends fights. One caution: Mantra-Inspire shields her whole nearby side, so time R for after she spends it, not into it.

edits.before: - Karma Focused Resolve: matchup-defining — Her root tether — breaks if you LoS / outrange it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Karma Focused Resolve (flat 12s): the root tether — it breaks on range, and Seismic Shard's speed steal is how you break it. - Mantra 40/38/36/34s, but Gathering Fire shortens it every time her damage lands.

edits.before: Track Karma's Focused Resolve: Her root tether — breaks if you LoS / outrange it. When it is down — Q-poke, R the pick.
edits.after: Focused Resolve tethers at 675 — Seismic Shard steals her speed and breaks it. R is displacement-immune once airborne.

edits.before: Unstoppable Force is a teamfight win button — the lane is just where you bank it. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Karma's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Your spike, not hers — Mantra was up from level 1, so nothing changes for Karma at 6. Unstoppable Force dashes displacement-immune past her root.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Core: Iceborn Gauntlet / Frozen Heart  (by his AD profile), then Thornmail / Abyssal Mask; boots Mercury's Treads.
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + pot. She is pure AP: Abyssal Mask into Kaenic Rookern; boots Mercury's Treads for the root. Some armor for Ground Slam.

notes: The biggest error in this matchup is a fabricated mechanic, not a misspelled name: 'RQ root' / 'RQ root-tether' appears about seven times across both layers as Karma's signature tool. Her root is Focused Resolve (W), a flat 12s tether at 675 range, and it has nothing to do with Q or Mantra. Two further things the page had backwards: Karma has Mantra from level 1 with no skill point, so she has NO level-6 spike at all — yet Level 6 is marked her stage in both layers and the full layer literally says 'Karma's ultimate changes the math too' at 6, while the same page's spikes[1] and whys[4] call Level 6 Malphite's single biggest spike. Level 6 should read Malphite; I could not propose the side flip because 'Karma' to 'Malphite' exceeds the applier's 10% length band (fourth matchup in this slice blocked by that). Also added the interaction that was missing entirely: Seismic Shard steals her move speed, which is exactly what breaks a range-based tether. R displacement immunity web-verified on League Wiki.
